prompts.background_extraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit target: the supplied utensil catalog photograph.
Remove only the warm off-white background and the floor/cast shadow, replacing them with genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the identical utensil and every component: same shape, proportions, count, placement, orientation, camera angle, size within the square frame, materials, colors, surface details, highlights and reflections. Do not redesign, redraw, relight, recompose or add anything. Keep edges crisp with natural antialiasing, retain holes and openings as transparent, and preserve the natural translucency of glass or mesh if present. No opaque backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no text or watermark. Output a transparent PNG with the original framing.

Critical glass matting requirement: all glass parts in this image are EMPTY, CLEAR, COLORLESS glass, not milk-filled or frosted glass. Remove the original off-white backdrop visible THROUGH the glass as well as outside its silhouette. Make optically clear interior areas genuinely transparent (low alpha) so a colored page background is visible through them. Preserve the thin original glass edges, thickness, rim, base, highlights, reflections and facets with appropriate partial alpha. Do not leave a solid white or cream fill inside the glass. Keep all non-glass components fully opaque and unchanged. Keep the exact same utensil design, proportions, position and framing.
